subject: Rubric-to-system move: it would not cache; numbers inside
body: You asked me to move the fixed judge/probe rubrics in measure.py into the system prompt so AnthropicLLM caching applies. I measured before changing anything: the fixed text is about 140-185 approx tokens per probe question and about 300 for the audit rubric; your CACHE_MIN_TOKENS is 512, and the API minimum for the dev judge (claude-haiku-4-5) is 4096 tokens. So a system prompt holding only the rubric is never marked and could not cache anyway. The only repeated long prefix is the transcript itself (3-5 probe questions plus the audit on the same transcript), and EvalAwareBench items are about 200 tokens median, 800 max; only long Needham agentic transcripts could reach 4096. Moving the transcript into a cached prefix would also change the calibrated EvalDetectBench probe format, which has to be settled before the calibration gate, not after. So I have NOT made the move; Nathan decides. If he wants it, the version that can actually cache is transcript-first as the cached block with the question after it, and I would do it before the gate runs so calibration covers the final prompts. Batch pricing (your anthropic-batch backend) is the saving that does apply to the judges.
